description: This file defines the TaxonomyPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of TaxonomyPart content items within OrchardCore CMS, including handling hierarchical taxonomy data and rendering logic.

classes.name: TaxonomyPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class for displaying, editing, and updating TaxonomyPart content items, including handling hierarchical taxonomy structures.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Generates the display view for a TaxonomyPart, showing either the taxonomy or an empty placeholder.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editing view for a TaxonomyPart.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous update process for a TaxonomyPart, including parsing hierarchy JSON and updating terms.

methods.name: GetTaxonomyItemAt
methods.description: Clones a taxonomy content item at a specific index path within the hierarchy.

methods.name: ProcessItem
methods.description: Processes a JSON object representing a taxonomy item, recursively handling child items.
